caption: The drawing features a single metallic mug with a handle, centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background. The mug appears cylindrical with a slightly wider base, narrowing slightly toward the rim. It has several horizontal bands etched around its body, and the surface reflects light, creating areas of shading and highlights that give it a three-dimensional appearance. The handle is attached to the right side, depicted in a simple, angular style. The drawing is done in shades of gray, suggestive of a pencil or charcoal medium, with careful attention to the tonal range to represent the reflective quality of the metal. At the bottom left corner, the name "Vincent Carano" is written in small, uppercase letters. There are no additional objects or patterns; the background remains empty except for some minor spots and marks.
title: Silver Mug
